fields.summary: How do I configure SAML SSO with Okta?
fields.description:
We are trying to set up SAML SSO using Okta as the identity provider, but the documentation doesn't cover the attribute mapping step. Can you provide guidance or an example config?

Our Okta tenant: company.okta.com

comments.body: Please check our documentation at docs.example.com/saml-okta
